title: Worklog Editor
description: Note + procedure authoring surface. Tiptap 3 + Yjs editor, server-backed draft sync, six mention types, alternate ProcedureDoc schema for kind='procedure', append-only version history, and the right-rail Properties tab. Renders inside the 2-pane (/worklog/notes) and single-note (/worklog/notes/[id]) routes; same WorklogNoteReader composes the dashboard embed and the route.

refreshHistory.summary: First produce-loop refresh. Dry-run flagged use-autosave-field.ts path stale (real: use-autosave.ts), flushAllFields aspirational (dropped), and worklog-draft-system knownTraps[0] too thin (expanded into 3 structural sub-bugs A/B/C).

ADR-0046 follow-up B shipped (commits 4b60788 / fb57906 / 6b06ddb). Added entryPoint editor-registry (module-singleton in-memory handle store) + traversal recipe how-does-ai-send-to-worklog-prepend-work. Extended worklog-draft-system knownTrap set: ai-prepend bypasses the autosave debounce and calls runSave directly so the PUT round-trip resolves before the toast fires. Extended version-history knownTrap set: WorkLogVersion.source column added (currently 'ai-prepend' is the only known non-null value, null = user-typed). Live PUT smoke confirmed WorkLogVersion.source persists 2026-06-24T00:13:55Z.

entryPoints.name: Server-backed draft sync
entryPoints.description: Per-field autosave with debounced server flush + IndexedDB persistence. Draft flush race: if the editor unmounts before the debounce fires, the pending write is lost. Triggered by ADR-0008 (capture acceleration) + ADR-0009 (server-backed draft sync).
knownTraps: Unmount race sub-bug A — stale-closure `value`: the cleanup effect in use-autosave.ts uses [] deps and captures `value` from first mount. The equality check against lastCommittedRef.current may either silently skip the rescue commit OR call commit(stale-initial-value) and wipe the field. lastCommittedRef works correctly (refs are mutable); only the React state `value` is captured stale. That asymmetry is what makes the bug subtle.

Unmount race sub-bug B — stale `commit` closure: parents typically inline `(v) => updateMutation.mutate({ id: log.id, title: v })`. log.id is captured at first mount of the cleanup effect, so if the user navigates to a different note before the previous reader fully unmounts, the cleanup writes the (also stale) value against the PREVIOUS log id — cross-note corruption potential.

Unmount race sub-bug C — draft timer has no flush fallback: cleanup clears draftTimerRef but never attempts a final draft POST. When sub-bug A causes the canonical commit to no-op, the safety-net draft row is ALSO never written. Both autosave layers fail together. Note: onBlur-triggered flush() does work because it reads `value` from React state at call time — only the unmount path goes through the stale closure.

AssetPicker auto-tag merge and editor mention-chip merge both read log.tags (server canonical) and write through onUpdate, bypassing per-field autosave. If user is typing in InlineTagsField when an asset is dropped, the asset's tag merge can clobber in-flight typing. Same failure mode on both surfaces — accepted, not a regression.
Hours autosave persistKey 'worklog:draft:<id>:hours' is shared between WorklogNoteReader and PropertiesFields — safe only because mount-skip via useIsXl ensures only one mounts at a time.

ADR-0046 follow-up B: the editor's imperative `prepend(content)` method DELIBERATELY bypasses the per-field autosave debounce. It calls `runSave({ json, text, versionSource: 'ai-prepend' })` synchronously so the PUT round-trip resolves before the returned promise — the toast wording in ai-chat-code-block depends on this ordering. Don't wrap `prepend` in the debounce or you'll surface 'Sent' before the WorkLogVersion row exists.

entryPoints.name: Tiptap 3 + Yjs editor
entryPoints.description: StarterKit (with undoRedo:false so Yjs owns history) plus custom inline atom nodes for six mention types. Editor mount switches by kind: kind='note' uses notes schema, kind='procedure' uses procedureDoc schema. ProseMirror-Markdown serializer does NOT know about custom atoms — we walk the JSON tree directly.
knownTraps: Tiptap 3 StarterKit ships Link built-in. Importing @tiptap/extension-link AND calling Link.configure(...) triggers `Duplicate extension names found: ['link']`. Disable via StarterKit.configure({ link: false }) at every callsite that registers a custom Link config.

Custom inline atom nodes (mention, tag, shiftBlock, moodBlock, photo, canvasBlock) live inside paragraph.content, NOT at doc root. Plain-text walkers must handle them in BOTH the top-level walker and the inline collector.

useEditor cannot accept null options — dereferences options.immediatelyRender synchronously and crashes. To conditionally mount, split into outer gating component + inner that always calls useEditor with valid options.
Six mention prefixes: @a (asset), @s (skill), @c (company), @p (contact/person), @n (note/worklog), @r (runbook/procedure). MENTION_PREFIX map lives in src/lib/worklog/export/pm-to-markdown.ts.

entryPoints.name: Procedure document schema (ADR-0030)
entryPoints.description: Top-level node `procedureDoc` with content expression `procedureTitle procedureTools? procedureStep+`. Step numbers are POSITIONAL (sibling index) — reorder renumbers automatically. ProcedureTools block is optional (L1). Editor toolbar is procedure-aware (+ Step / ↑ ↓ / Title). Migration script wraps freeform body into a single procedureStep named 'Body'.
knownTraps: ProseMirrorDoc.type widened to 'doc' | 'procedureDoc' in src/lib/worklog/import/types.ts — markdown export branches on doc.type.
Procedure-only nodes (procedureTitle/procedureTools/procedureStep) are NEVER added to droppedBlocks — they have semantic emit rules.

PUT /api/work-logs/[id] route deliberately PRESERVES kind (cannot be flipped via update). POST is stricter — present-but-unknown kind returns 400. Search defaults to kind=note unless ?kind=procedure is passed.

entryPoints.name: Version history (ADR-0017)
entryPoints.description: Append-only WorkLogVersion table; PUT /api/work-logs/[id] writes best-effort auto-snapshot before saving. Restore writes a 'Before restore from <ts>' pre-snapshot first, then overwrites. Plain-text LCS diff at word / horizontal-whitespace / newline-token granularity. UI mounts ONLY on full-screen route (/worklog/notes/[id]) via WorklogHistoryPanel.
knownTraps: Next.js 16 / React 19 BLOCKS window.prompt() / window.confirm() in dev mode — throws 'Error: prompt() is not supported.' Save Version + Restore both use controlled base-ui Dialog with useState. Don't even try prompt/confirm/alert in any new client component.
Y.js sync after restore is PARKED — POST .../restore overwrites server-side contentJson but doesn't broadcast a Y.update to OTHER open editor sessions. They keep stale Y.Doc until next reload.
Diff list endpoint returns truncated 200-char preview; per-version GET (/versions/[versionId]) is REQUIRED for the diff modal.
Auto-snapshot failures are logged via [ADR-0017] auto-snapshot write failed but never fail the user's save — best-effort guarantee.

ADR-0046 follow-up B: WorkLogVersion.source is an OPTIONAL provenance string (column added 2026-06-23, migration 20260623194421_add_worklog_version_source). Currently 'ai-prepend' is the only known non-null value — null means user-typed. Validated at the PUT boundary as 'non-empty string when provided' (400 otherwise). Surface this in any future version-history UI that filters by provenance.

entryPoints.name: Right-rail Properties tab (ADR-0023 + ADR-0025)
entryPoints.description: Single right-rail tab consolidating Tags + Assets + Tools + Backlinks + Version history sections. xl+ canonical edit surface; inline mounts (xl:hidden) survive at < xl. Three Inline*Field components (dual-surface pattern) own autosave; backlinks + version history are wrapped in max-h-64 overflow-y-auto sections.
knownTraps: useReaderRailState MUST use useQuery (not queryClient.getQueryData) — getQueryData is a one-shot snapshot, so optimistic setQueryData writes never re-render. Migration to useQuery in Unit 3 fixed the silent tab-click failure.

Legacy rail tab values ('tags' | 'backlinks' | 'history') alias to 'properties' at every read/write boundary via migrateLegacyRailTab in rail-tabs.ts — both useReaderRailState (client read) AND /api/work-logs/preferences/reader-rail (server write) normalize. No DB migration needed.

Rail unmounts entirely when activeNoteId is null. Mounted as flex sibling of WorklogNoteReader in TWO places: WorklogNotesAndReader (dashboard 2-pane) AND /worklog/notes/[id]/page.tsx. Both surfaces must mount the rail or Backlinks/History/Photos surface disappears from that route entirely.

entryPoints.name: In-memory editor handle registry (ADR-0046 follow-up B)
entryPoints.description: Module-singleton `Map<string, RegisteredWorklogEditor>` keyed by workLogId. Mounted editors (kind='note' only) register an imperative `prepend(content)` handle on mount and dispose on unmount. The AI chat panel's send-to-worklog action awaits `waitForEditor(id, 500)` before deciding to prepend in-page vs. fall back to the legacy create-new POST. Client-only (module shared across the React tree, no SSR boundary crossings). Procedure-kind editors INTENTIONALLY do not register (locked schema).
knownTraps: Last-write-wins: a second register() call for the same id silently replaces the first handle. By design — re-mount during HMR or fast navigation should not strand an old handle.

500ms timeout in `waitForEditor` is the only seam between the chat panel and the editor mount. Polling at 50ms means up to 10 ticks before fallthrough — enough for a normal mount but DON'T raise it without measuring real-world mount latency.

Exported type was renamed from WorklogEditorHandle to RegisteredWorklogEditor (commit 6b06ddb) because worklog-editor.tsx already exports an unrelated WorklogEditorHandle imperative-ref interface. Don't restore the old name — the collision is real.
`__resetEditorRegistry` is a test-only seam; calling it from app code wipes every mounted editor's handle and breaks every in-flight Send-to-Worklog action.
Registry is INTENTIONALLY not React-context — it must be reachable from any code-block render path even when the chat panel and the editor live in different React subtrees (or one is in a portal).

traversalRecipes.intent: Where does the Tiptap editor mount for a worklog note?
steps: Open src/components/worklog/worklog-editor.tsx — top-level <WorklogEditor> client component.
useEditor() call dereferences immediatelyRender synchronously — outer component MUST gate on log existence before mounting inner editor.
kind discriminator switches schema: kind='note' uses notes schema (SCHEMA_EXTENSIONS), kind='procedure' uses procedureDoc schema from src/lib/worklog/procedure/schema.ts.

traversalRecipes.intent: Why did my note text disappear after navigating away quickly?
steps: Check entryPoints.worklog-draft-system.knownTraps[0..2] — the unmount race breaks into three structural sub-bugs (A: stale-closure value, B: stale commit closure, C: no draft-timer flush fallback). The user-visible symptom is one bug; the cause is three.

Open src/components/worklog/hooks/use-autosave.ts and find the unmount cleanup effect (useEffect with [] deps returning a cleanup that clears timerRef + draftTimerRef). The closed-over `value` is the root of sub-bug A.
Look at any callsite, e.g. src/components/worklog/worklog-note-reader.tsx — the inline `(v) => updateMutation.mutate({ id: log.id, ... })` captures log.id at first mount (sub-bug B).

Reproduce: type text in a note → click a different note within ~700–800 ms → reader unmounts → server has no record → reopening shows pre-edit text. Same failure mode hits both PUT and draft POST simultaneously.

traversalRecipes.intent: Add a new entity type that users can chip into notes with @<prefix>:.
steps: Follow docs/workflows/wire-mention-entity-type.md (currently at rev 4).
Recipe step 1: confirm Prisma model has a primary display field (title/name/company) — never derive chip label from a secondary projection.
Recipe step 2: extend MENTION_PREFIX in src/lib/worklog/export/pm-to-markdown.ts.
Recipe step 3: mention-search route must include the same field as label in its search clause (OR: [{ title: contains }, { content: contains }]).
Recipe step 4: if the new type shares a Prisma model via a discriminator column (kind), EXISTING mention-search cases for that model MUST be retroactively scoped to their kind too.

traversalRecipes.intent: How does manual save-version and restore work?
steps: WorklogEditorToolbar shows BookmarkPlus button when workLogId prop is set — opens controlled Dialog (NOT window.prompt — blocked in Next.js 16).
POST /api/work-logs/[id]/versions with { label, isManual:true } creates the WorkLogVersion row.

Restore from WorklogHistoryPanel: row click → WorklogVersionDiffModal (fetches FULL snapshot via GET /api/work-logs/[id]/versions/[versionId]) → Restore button → controlled Dialog confirm → POST /api/work-logs/[id]/versions/[versionId]/restore writes 'Before restore from <ts>' pre-snapshot first, then overwrites contentJson + content.
Mutation invalidates ['work-logs'] AND ['worklog-versions', noteId].

traversalRecipes.intent: How does the right-rail remember which tab was open?
steps: useReaderRailState uses useQuery on ['worklog-preferences'] (shared cache with useWorklogPreferences via TanStack v5 dedupe).
POST /api/work-logs/preferences/reader-rail persists tab + collapsed state with partial-update semantics.

Legacy tab ids ('tags' | 'backlinks' | 'history') alias to 'properties' via migrateLegacyRailTab — applied on both client read AND server write boundaries (rail-tabs.ts is the single source of truth for the alias set).

traversalRecipes.intent: Trace what happens when the user clicks 'Worklog' on an AI code block while a note is open in EDIT mode.
steps: User clicks the Worklog action button on an AIChatCodeBlock. handleAction('send-to-worklog') (src/components/ai-chat-code-block.tsx).
Branch reads `pageContext.activeWorklog?.id` — populated by the URL-aware ambient pipeline (see ai-chat slice traversal 'how-does-the-chat-panel-know-which-worklog-i-m-on').
If an active id exists, `waitForEditor(activeId, 500)` polls the editor-registry (src/lib/worklog/editor-registry.ts) at 50ms intervals.

Editor mount path: WorklogNoteReader edit-mode → WorklogEditor → EditorBody → useEffect calls `registerEditor({ id, kind: 'note', prepend })`. Procedure-kind mounts SKIP registration on purpose (locked schema).

If the handle resolves AND kind === 'note': `handle.prepend(code)` runs `editor.chain().focus('start').insertContentAt(0, code).run()` then `await runSave({ json, text, versionSource: 'ai-prepend' })`. runSave bypasses the debounce so the PUT resolves before the toast.

runSave threads through WorklogNoteReader.onSave → onUpdate (which spreads versionSource into the PATCH payload) → useWorklogMutations.saveLog → PUT /api/work-logs/[id] with body.versionSource = 'ai-prepend'.

PUT handler validates versionSource (non-empty string), then in the auto-snapshot block writes `prisma.workLogVersion.create({ data: { ..., source: versionSource ?? null } })`. Live smoke 2026-06-24T00:13:55Z confirmed the column populates.

Fallthrough cases: no activeWorklog, 500ms timeout, non-note kind, or handle.prepend throws — branch falls back to `postAction(action, { content: code })` which POSTs /api/ai/actions/send-to-worklog and creates a brand-new WorkLog (legacy v1 behaviour).

traversalRecipes.intent: How does procedure markdown export differ from regular note export?
steps: serializeToMarkdown in src/lib/worklog/export/pm-to-markdown.ts branches on doc.type.

doc.type='procedureDoc' → procedure-aware walker: procedureTitle → '# <text>', procedureTools → '## Tools\n\n<body>' (skip if empty), procedureStep → '## Step N' or '## Step N — <title>' with U+2014 em dash. N is POSITIONAL starting at 1.
doc.type='doc' → existing emitBlock fallthrough.
Re-import via decideImport in src/lib/worklog/import/grill-frontmatter.ts — frontmatter `id` + `version` (count of WorkLogVersion rows) routes to match/conflict/needs-picker/not-found.

fileFingerprints.notes: ADR-0046 follow-up B (commit 6b06ddb): WorklogEditorHandle gained prepend(content), WorklogEditorChange gained optional versionSource, EditorBody useEffect registers handle with editor-registry on mount when kind='note'.
ADR-0046 follow-up B: onSave threads versionSource from the change payload through onUpdate so it reaches the PUT body.
ADR-0046 follow-up B: saveLog input widened to accept versionSource; onMutate destructures it out so it does not leak into optimistically-cached row state.

NEW in ADR-0046 follow-up B (commit fb57906). Module-singleton Map<string, RegisteredWorklogEditor> with registerEditor / getEditor / waitForEditor / __resetEditorRegistry. 8 TDD specs in sibling .test.ts.

ADR-0046 follow-up B (commit fb57906): PUT body validator accepts optional versionSource (non-empty string, 400 otherwise); auto-snapshot writer threads source: versionSource ?? null into WorkLogVersion.create.
